plan_base_month.description: Fixed recurring plan or cluster fee, independent of usage.

compute_vcpu_hour.description: Charge per virtual CPU per hour of running compute.

compute_cu_hour.description: Charge per provider-defined compute unit per hour, where vCPU and memory are bundled.

memory_gib_hour.description: Charge per gibibyte of memory per hour, where memory is billed separately from vCPU.

storage_gib_month.description: Charge per gibibyte of persistent database storage per month.

egress_gib.description: Charge per gibibyte of outbound data transfer to the public internet.

read_ops_million.description: Charge per million read operations, for providers billing by operation.

write_ops_million.description: Charge per million write operations, for providers billing by operation.

backup_gib_month.description: Charge per gibibyte of backup storage per month beyond any included retention.

block_storage_gib_month.description: Charge per gibibyte of persistent block-volume capacity per month, assuming the performance baseline (IOPS/throughput) included with the volume type. Excludes provisioned IOPS or throughput bought beyond that baseline.

snapshot_gib_month.description: Charge per gibibyte of retained block-volume snapshot storage per month. Providers typically bill snapshots incrementally on changed blocks rather than as a full copy of the source volume.
